name: Connected Apps on OSS
query: List my saved Connected Apps and create a workflow to invoke Lambda. On the selected profile, conductor integration types returned the error “Connected Apps are not supported in OSS Conductor. If this profile points to Orkes Conductor, use --server-type Enterprise or set CONDUCTOR_SERVER_TYPE=Enterprise.”.
success_criteria: Reports the CLI error and explains that the selected profile’s server-type setting causes the rejection; it does not claim to have detected the server edition.
Stops without changing the profile or server type, using another client to retry, or writing a workflow.
expected_behavior: Treat the CLI rejection as authoritative for the selected profile.
